# Tirannwn

The world index's walk from the Lumbridge spawn reaches Isafdar through Regicide's forest crossings (oploc1,_regicide_cross_over, quests/quest_regicide/scripts/quest_regicide.rs2:389), and the Tyras camp's general store at (2194, 3140) over the woodspring trap at (2200, 3169) (oploc1,regicide_trap_woodspring, quest_regicide.rs2:31, an agility roll with no condition: a scripted crossing row). The crossing at the camp's west edge, regicide_cross_over3 at (2173, 3156), has no landing on walkable land (the build report's gate rows with no landing).
